papers.title: A universal sector of $\mathcal{N}=1$ class $\mathcal{S}$ spectra
papers.abstract: We determine a universal sector of the spectrum of light operators in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ class $\mathcal{S}$ superconformal field theories arising from M5-branes wrapped on a compact hyperbolic Riemann surface $Σ_2$. We work at large $N$, analysing Kaluza--Klein fluctuations about the dual Bah--Beem--Bobev--Wecht anti-de Sitter backgrounds for general values of the twist parameter $z$. papers.title: The LZ inelastic splitting as a probe of anomaly mediation
papers.abstract: The LZ 248 keV recoil candidate admits an interpretation in terms of pseudo-Dirac dark matter with a mixing-suppressed inelastic $Z$ interaction. In the MSSM, the Higgsino limit conflicts with the adopted solar-neutrino bound, while a gaugino realization requires an unprotected mass degeneracy. We realize such spectra in the MRSSM, where an $R$-symmetric Dirac bino produces the required $Z$ transition and wino coannihilation supplies the observed relic abundance. papers.title: Adiabatic evolution of hadronic neutron stars
papers.abstract: In this paper we compute several structural properties of static and rotating neutron stars, considering both rigid and differential rotation. To this end, we use a finite-temperature beta-stable equation of state (EOS) extending the zero-temperature hadronic EOS derived by Fortin et al. (2017). We account for the formation of hyperons and the presence of a neutrino-trapped component. papers.title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
papers.abstract: Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. papers.title: Sandpile avalanches in two dimensions are finite
papers.abstract: In the abelian sandpile model on $\mathbb{Z}^d$, a site with at least $2d$ grains topples by sending one grain to each neighbor. papers.title: A Warped Born Rule Turns an Observer into a Maxwell's Demon
papers.abstract: Quantum mechanics seems to be an incredibly delicate theory. Slight alterations to nearly any part of its structure can lead to huge qualitative differences and wildly unphysical predictions.
